title: Malik Nabers has full practice, appears "ready to go" for season opener

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Malik Nabers has full practice, appears "ready to go" for season opener
sources.description: Wide receiver Malik Nabers has not played in almost a year, since tearing his right ACL in a Sept. 28 game against the Chargers.
